open_decision: Whether a lock file is removed when the owner pid is unknown and the age of the lock is unknown.
input: {pidKnown := false, alive := false, reused := false, age := none, staleAfter := 0}
result_a: Design A (ref) returns false: keep the lock file.
result_b: Design B (ref, but true when pidKnown is false and age is none) returns true: remove the lock file.
reason: Each law about an unknown owner needs age = some a, and each law about a known owner needs pidKnown = true. No law constrains pidKnown = false with age = none, so two rules can pass every law and still differ there.
